$comment: Valenor Studio version feed, read by versionChecker.lua. Updated by Valenor Portal.

changes: This is an experimental update, please back up your current version before installing and report any issues
Fixed FPS drops and stutter in the appearance menu, especially in the face, clothing and tattoo views.
Improved performance when changing clothes and syncing other players' looks.
Fixed clothes clipping after changing a colour or dye.
Fixed under-layers clipping after toggling a coat with commands like /coat.
Improved how shirts sit under NPC vests and coats.
Fixed faces looking different to other players than to the owner.
Added syncing of clothing fit, body fit and shirt layering, so other players see the same fit.
Fixed makeup and eyebrows sometimes missing after spawn.
Fixed addon emotes such as the gang signs and the pose packs not playing since 2.0.0.
(If some emotes still do not play after updating: close RedM fully and delete
